title: Lab - Control plane failure
description: Repair a cluster whose control plane is broken.
scenario: Repair a cluster whose control plane is broken. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Scheduler
tasks.instructions: New Pods stay Pending. Find the typo in the kube-scheduler manifest and fix it.
tasks.solution:
kubectl get pods -n kube-system
kubectl logs -n kube-system kube-scheduler-controlplane  # or crictl logs
tasks.verification: kubectl get pods -n kube-system  # scheduler Running

tasks.title: Task 2 - Controller manager
tasks.instructions: Scaling a Deployment does nothing. Check the controller manager.
tasks.solution:
kubectl describe pod -n kube-system kube-controller-manager-controlplane | tail
# fix the config path / certificate path

tasks.title: Task 3 - Certificates
tasks.instructions: The controller manager cannot find its CA file. Fix the hostPath mount.
